query: Which electoral statute is currently in force for Nigerian general elections?
current_2026_requirement: Electoral Act 2026 signed on 18 February 2026 repeals the 2022 Act.
forbidden_phrase: Electoral Act 2022 is the current law

query: What is the notice period for general elections under the current law?
current_2026_requirement: Section 28 of Electoral Act 2026 specifies the notice requirement for the 2027 cycle.

query: How is electronic transmission of results mandated under the 2026 guidelines?
repealed_2022_answer: Discretionary pursuant to Section 60(5) of the 2022 Act as interpreted in 2023.
current_2026_requirement: Mandatory real-time direct upload of Form EC8A via BVAS to the collation server pursuant to INEC Regulations 2026 Clause 38.

query: What is the status of Section 29A regarding pre-election jurisdiction?
repealed_2022_answer: Section 29(5) Federal High Court exclusive jurisdiction under 2022 Act.
current_2026_requirement: PASSED_BILL_AWAITING_GAZETTE. Explicitly disclose that Section 29A has passed the National Assembly but awaits formal presidential assent and official gazetting.
forbidden_phrase: Section 29A is fully enacted with gazetted presidential assent
